rules.statement: A party relying on a notarially executed deed to transfer immovable property must prove the document as required by law, specifically by calling an attesting witness to prove its execution, unless there is a written admission recorded at the trial.
rules.supporting_quote: Section 68; If a document is required by law to be attested, it should not be used as evidence until one attesting witness at least has been called for the purpose of proving its execution, if there be an attesting witness alive, and subject to the process of the court and capable of giving evidence
